import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    m = int(input[1])
    s = input[2:2+n]
    t = input[2+n:2+n+m]
    q = int(input[2+n+m])
    queries = list(map(int, input[2+n+m+1:]))

    for y in queries:
        sy = s[(y-1) % n]
        ty = t[(y-1) % m]
        print(sy + ty)
